name: What factors can delay a cash home sale closing?

mainEntity.name: What factors can delay a cash home sale closing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Even cash sales can experience delays due to issues like title defects (e.g., liens, clouded title), unpermitted work, or unexpected issues during the home inspection. Ensuring a clear title is paramount. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution works proactively with title companies to identify and address potential hurdles early in the process for properties in South Florida.
acceptedAnswer.description: Title issues, unpermitted work, or inspection findings can delay a cash closing. A clear title is crucial.
